opening.argument: The video presents a practical product review and demonstration of accessing Microsoft Office through Office.com, beginning with the stated ability to use Word, Excel, and PowerPoint “entirely for free.” Viewers are shown the sign-in flow, including free account creation, and the available browser tools are demonstrated through document creation and collaboration. The terms are also described plainly: the applications are available online with an internet connection, while Microsoft charges for offline access. A separate subscription link discloses that it generates a small commission and that the viewer's price remains the same. The records do not independently verify the linked service or every product claim.

citations.quote: Today I want to show you how you can get Microsoft Office, which includes such popular programs like Word, and Excel and PowerPoint, entirely for free.
all of this, the Word, Excel, PowerPoint, this is all available online so you need an internet connection to be able to take advantage of it
if you want offline access though, that's where Microsoft charges you then.
purchasing through this link gives me a small commission to support videos on this channel -- the price to you is the same
